description: Defines template classes for graphics buffer management, including local, shared, client, and server buffer types with synchronization, memory mapping, and buffer state handling.

classes.name: LocalBufferType
classes.description: Template class managing local graphics buffers with iterator support and synchronization.

classes.name: SharedBufferType
classes.description: Template class managing shared graphics buffers with memory mapping, synchronization, and buffer state control.

classes.name: ClientBufferType
classes.description: Derived class for client-side buffer handling, extending SharedBufferType with request and event handling.

classes.name: ServerBufferType
classes.description: Derived class for server-side buffer handling, extending SharedBufferType with load and state management.

classes.name: SharedStorageType
classes.description: Internal class for shared memory storage with buffer metadata and state management.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing buffer planes in LocalBufferType and SharedBufferType.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Locks the buffer and returns an iterator for buffer planes.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads buffer descriptors from external source.

methods.name: RequestRender
methods.description: Requests buffer rendering, handling state transitions.

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Marks buffer as published, handling state transitions.

methods.name: Rendered
methods.description: Marks buffer as rendered, handling state transitions.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles IResource events for buffer synchronization.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests buffer state change to requested.
